dag_infos.description: Taiwan employed persons by industry and occupation, age group and year, from DGBAS manpower-survey XML.

data_infos.name_cn: 就業者之行業／職業及年齡
data_infos.source_type: 行政院主計總處人力資源調查 XML
data_infos.dataset_description: 資料集36787與36788提供就業者之教育程度與年齡按行業／職業分的年度千人數。本DAG保留行業與職業維度、未分齡來源總計及非空的11個年齡組，涵蓋民國110至114年。
data_infos.etl_description: Resolve each year's XML resource URL from the server-rendered data.gov.tw page, rather than hard-coding the upload path. Parse item, total and age fields by role aliases; retain suppressed '-' age cells as unavailable rather than zero, emit source-total rows separately, and reconcile source totals and numeric age-cell output independently. Emit raw age-group counts for both industry and occupation dimensions, apply a three-times-median guard to the total item across years, and do not materialize an 18-35 estimate.
